summary: chromacli ships a Windows dropper disguised as an ANSI color library
details: chromacli presents itself as an ANSI color-printing helper, but core.py contains a Windows-only payload that fires the first time any Color method (paint, print, __call__) is used. The payload creates %TEMP%\SolaceRuntime, invokes PowerShell with -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass and CREATE_NO_WINDOW to add Microsoft Defender ExclusionPath/ExclusionProcess entries for that directory and the dropped executable, downloads an unsigned Windows binary (solace.exe) from a Discord CDN attachment URL (cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1442967767853563904/1568919645207920720/solace.exe), writes it to disk, and launches it with subprocess.Popen using DETACHED_PROCESS. The color-printing surface in colors.py is unrelated to this logic and functions as a cover story. The payload is gated by os.name == 'nt' and a one-shot flag so it runs silently on Windows installers and is dormant elsewhere.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
